name: Warlord Goretooth
summary: At Kargath, Warlord Goretooth directs the Horde's frontier campaigns. From his tower, he watches the Dark Iron dwarves and the danger of Blackrock Mountain. At times, he leaves his lookout to relax by the campfire.

sections.title: Commander of Kargath
sections.body:
Warlord Goretooth directs Horde operations from Kargath's watchtower. The outpost is Orgrimmar's main staging ground against dangers in Blackrock Mountain and the ravines around it. Goretooth oversees patrols and coordinates scouts such as the Kargath Expeditionary Force. He also orders attacks on the Dark Iron clan's ranks and leaders.

Away from his lookout, the stern commander sometimes warms himself by the campfire. There, he trades quips with the Forsaken casters before returning to duty.

sections.title: Striking the Dark Irons
sections.body:
Warlord Goretooth sees the Dark Iron dwarves as a direct threat to Horde interests in the Eastern Kingdoms. He favors attacks over defense and plans strikes against General Angerforge and Emperor Dagran Thaurissan's forces in Blackrock Depths. Assaulting an ancient stronghold beneath the earth is no small undertaking.

Before approving another push into the mountain, Goretooth often seeks counsel from veteran orcs such as Eitrigg in Orgrimmar.

faq.answer: Warlord Goretooth commands the Horde forces stationed at Kargath in the Badlands. He organizes patrols and directs attacks against the Dark Iron dwarves.

faq.q: What is his role in Kargath?
faq.answer: Warlord Goretooth commands Kargath and sends the Kargath Expeditionary Force into the field. He orders operations against the Dark Iron clan in Blackrock Depths.

faq.q: Why is Goretooth sending soldiers against Blackrock Depths?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron dwarves threaten the surrounding regions and oppose the Horde's presence. Goretooth orders attacks on their soldiers, senior officers, and General Angerforge to weaken their hold on the mountain.
Eitrigg is a veteran orc who lived inside Blackrock Mountain and knows its politics and defenses. Goretooth seeks his counsel before escalating attacks on Blackrock strongholds.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can see how Warlord Goretooth directs its operations against the Dark Iron dwarves from Kargath.
As a warrior, you can face the seasoned dwarven legionnaires targeted by Goretooth's direct military orders.
